author: mothership:clinical-informatics
request: Ship an end-to-end regression suite that every landed change soaks against before it turns green
purpose: A change can pass the single-answer tiers and still break a flow that spans several steps. The platform runs these scenarios against each fork's live main after every change lands (yellow), three times in a row, and rolls main back to the last green commit on a failure. The suite is read from stock at the pinned tag, like tiers 1 and 2.
